tickets_assigned_has_worker_and_due_date.name: tickets_assigned_has_worker_and_due_date
tickets_assigned_has_worker_and_due_date.value: "tickets"."status" in ('Reported', 'Cancelled', 'Duplicate', 'Won''t fix') or ("tickets"."assignee_id" is not null and "tickets"."due_date" is not null)

announcements_audience_target.name: announcements_audience_target
announcements_audience_target.value:
(
        ("announcements"."audience" = 'All'
          AND "announcements"."target_block_id" IS NULL
          AND "announcements"."target_floor" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("announcements"."audience" = 'Block'
          AND "announcements"."target_block_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "announcements"."target_floor" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("announcements"."audience" = 'Floor'
          AND "announcements"."target_block_id" IS NULL
          AND "announcements"."target_floor" IS NOT NULL)
      )
